telemetry_only.description: Hold settlements whenever the telemetry channel dissents. One loud channel, no corroboration.

storefront_only.description: Hold settlements whenever the storefront channel dissents from the declaration.

gate_removed.description: Sentinel's ladder and triage, with the two-channel requirement deleted: a hold on any single dissent. Isolates the gate itself from everything else the system does.

two_channel_gate.description: Sentinel. A hold requires storefront dissent plus a second independent channel; single-channel dissent produces review with settlements running.

no_monitoring.description: Do nothing after onboarding. The counterfactual the whole system is measured against.

modality.finding: Recall at analyst review moves from 0.42 to 0.69 while wrong settlement holds stay at 0. The graph carries the funnel archetype specifically: ring recall goes 0.43 -> 1.00, because a funnel member is unremarkable alone by construction and nothing about the merchant itself will ever select it.
modality.voice_note: Voice does not move recall and is not measured on that axis. It is only placed on merchants already heading for action, so by construction it cannot surface a new case. What it changes is corroboration: merchants with two or more independent dissenting views go from 28 to 29. That is the axis a verification call belongs on.

contradiction_quality.note: Two independent views contradicting the declaration is the bar for restricting settlements. The count of legitimate merchants that reach it is the number that has to stay near zero.

voice_channel.note: Most calls yield nothing, and a diverged merchant that answers more often restates its declared business than admits the change. The channel is worth having because a contradiction is strong when it happens, not because it happens often.

_telemetry_blind_cases.note: Recall on these comes from the storefront channel and the rotation trigger. Telemetry contributes nothing by construction.

rule.description: round-value share >= 0.60 OR repeat velocity >= 4.0 OR night-hours share >= 0.30, applied to every merchant regardless of declared category
rule.note: The categories in this list are the argument for per-category baselines: legitimate merchants whose honest behaviour is unusual for the population and ordinary for themselves.

cache.note: Content-addressed by rendered page, so a merchant that has not touched its checkout costs nothing to re-examine. The cold number is the one to plan capacity against; the warm number is what a steady-state day costs.

injection.note: A page carrying text addressed to an automated classifier is recorded as its own suspicion signal. No legitimate merchant has any reason to instruct a reviewing model.

determinism.note: storefront_seed_reference values are fixed constants. If they differ between runs or machines, seeding has regressed to a process-local hash and no verdict is reproducible.

case.justification: The storefront disagrees with the declaration and nothing else does. That is enough to ask the merchant directly, and not enough to touch their money. It is also the correct outcome for a licensing or disclosure violation, which the storefront can see and telemetry structurally cannot: an unregistered pharmacy has the same payment shape as a registered one.

case.narrative: Merchant MID100057 declared home_furnishing at onboarding 744 days ago. Telemetry agrees: the largest deviations from the home_furnishing baseline are round_share_recent at +3.4 sigma (observed 0.538 against a category baseline of 0.139), round_share_all at +3.3 sigma (observed 0.513 against a category baseline of 0.138), chargeback_drift at -3.0 sigma (observed -0.00764 against a category baseline of 0). The checkout surface presents a unlicensed_lending interface at 0.99 confidence, against a declared category of home_furnishing. This vertical cannot be approved on this platform. A verification call was placed and produced no usable statement, which counts neither for nor against the merchant. In total 1 independent view of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 4 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier is a merchant verification call. Settlements continue: one dissenting view is enough to ask, not to hold. A model is 0.99 confident, but only 1 independent view dissents -- model confidence is not evidence agreement, and the action reflects the latter.
